name: bug_scroll_offsets_hit_test
description: SCROLL vs HIT-TEST (live bug, 0.2.0): scrolling repainted correctly but CpuHitTester tested clicks against STATIC layout rects — after scrolling, clicks landed on the pre-scroll node. Repro: 10x 50px focusable rows in a 100px-tall overflow-y:scroll container. A click at (100,75) lands in row1 (y 50..100). Scroll by 120, then click the SAME window point: on screen that point now shows row3 (content y = 75+120 = 195, inside 150..200). Pre-fix the second click focused r1 again (static rects); the fix applies the ancestor scroll chain at query time (point + sum(offsets) vs static rect, the same pos-offset rule cpurender paints with), so it must focus r3. Also asserts the first click still works (no-scroll behavior unchanged) and that a click BELOW the 100px viewport (y=150, on r6's static rect but outside the scroller's on-screen box) falls through to the body — the scroller's viewport clip must NOT move with its content.
